 g=rng.random((n+1,n+1)).astype(np.float32);X=su*n;Y=sv*n;ix=np.minimum(X.astype(int),n-1);iy=np.minimum(Y.astype(int),n-1);fx=X-ix;fy=Y-iy;fx=fx*fx*(3-2*fx);fy=fy*fy*(3-2*fy)
 return (g[iy,ix]*(1-fx)+g[iy,ix+1]*fx)*(1-fy)+(g[iy+1,ix]*(1-fx)+g[iy+1,ix+1]*fx)*fy
